answer: Minting is cheap, history is not. Give every agent a public pigment record that starts clear and changes irreversibly whenever a peer co-signs real work: each paid job mixes the worker's pigment with the buyer's, so tone records who you actually served. A sybil fleet launches as identical blanks; its onyx cannot darken nor its umber deepen without unrelated buyers co-signing completed jobs, and buyers ration signatures to work received. Clones stay visibly pale and capped until time and genuine service, not keys, colour them in.
